description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrandedDialogFragment' that extends Android's 'DialogFragment' and implements 'Branded'. It overrides the 'onStart' method to apply branding colors, utilizing a utility class 'BrandingUtil'.

classes.name: BrandedDialogFragment
classes.description: An abstract dialog fragment that applies branding colors in its lifecycle.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the lifecycle method to set branding colors when the dialog fragment starts.
